root_causes.description: product-catalog service experienced extreme p99 latency spike (z>1000) with concurrent high CPU (z=+5.84) and high memory (z=+5.09) usage, causing downstream dependency failures
recommendation service showed extreme memory pressure (z=+16.59) and severe latency degradation (z>1000), likely downstream effect of product-catalog dependency failure

frontend entry point showed elevated p99 latency (z=+524.64) and memory increase (z=+2.88), but topology analysis confirms these are propagated symptoms from downstream product-catalog and recommendation failures rather than primary cause

evidence.observed_value: no pod restart events observed for frontend during incident window

remediation_steps: Investigate product-catalog service resource limits and database query performance - extreme latency (z>1000) suggests DB bottleneck or resource exhaustion
Apply memory pressure mitigation to recommendation service and verify product-catalog API response times recover
Monitor frontend latency as indicator of downstream dependency health; if product-catalog recovers, frontend should normalize
